parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multipart upload event

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of parts in the OSS response.

Default value: 1,000

Maximum value: 1,000
parameters.help_zh:
规定在OSS响应中的最大Part数目。

默认值：1,000

最大值：1,000
parameters.name: max_parts

parameters.help_en:
The starting position of the list. Only parts with part numbers greater than this parameter value are listed.
Default value: None
parameters.help_zh:
指定List的起始位置，只有Part Number数目大于该参数的Part会被列出。
默认值：无
parameters.name: part_number_marker

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the encoding type for the returned content. Keys use UTF-8 characters, but XML 1.0 does not support parsing certain control characters, such as characters with ASCII values from 0 to 10. If a key contains control characters that are not supported by XML 1.0, you can specify Encoding-type to encode the returned keys.

Default value: None

Valid values: url
parameters.help_zh:
指定对返回的内容进行编码，指定编码的类型。Key使用UTF-8字符，但xml 1.0标准不支持解析一些控制字符，比如ascii值从0到10的字符。对于Key中包含xml 1.0标准不支持的控制字符，可以通过指定Encoding-type对返回的Key进行编码。

默认值：无

可选值：url
parameters.name: encoding_type
